parts.label: (a)
parts.answer: The graphs intersect exactly once for $0<x<\pi$.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: B1: sketch a relevant graph, e.g. y = e^x − 3, with correct shape and vertical intercept. [Total: 2]

parts.label: (c)
parts.answer: At convergence, $x=\ln(\cosec(x/2)+3)$, which rearranges to $\cosec(x/2)=e^x-3$, so the limit is $\alpha$.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: B1 AG: state x = ln(cosec(x/2) + 3) and rearrange to cosec(x/2) = e^x − 3, or reverse these steps to obtain the iterative formula. [Total: 1]
